unit.why: An anecdote told by the author's uncle R. Zvi (Hirsh of Zhidachov): he was driven out of Brody in disgrace on a Friday, reached Podkamin without Sabbath clothes, and on the Sabbath experienced an unprecedented illumination; it closes with a short teaching.

stories.start_quote: וסיפר לי מו״ר דודי הק׳ רבינו צבי
stories.summary_en: R. Zvi Hirsh tells that every Sabbath eve he suffers humiliation in order to merit the Sabbath light. Once he was chased out of Brody in great disgrace and reached Podkamin at nightfall without Sabbath clothes. On the Sabbath his prayer was illuminated as never before, which he takes as a teaching on accepting suffering and humiliation with love and on studying Zohar and Lurianic writings.

tags.why: The whole story turns on Sabbath eve and the Sabbath light
